description: This file is a shell script for testing repository ACL configurations, specifically verifying the setup and preservation of ACLs in a git repository environment. It includes commands for creating test conditions, checking ACL settings, and performing git operations to ensure ACL integrity.

methods.name: check_perms_and_acl
methods.description: Verifies that a file has correct ACL permissions for root and the current user, and that the ACL mask is set correctly.
